title: Compatibility testing: browser, operating system, device and resolution

videos.script: boxoffice works in your browser. That is one cell of a much bigger table. {{one-cell}} Your customers use other browsers, on other systems, on phones far narrower than your screen. {{matrix}} Compatibility testing checks the product where its users actually run it. {{where}} There are more combinations than anybody has time for, so you choose. {{choose}} You choose with two things: who the customers are, and where the product is likely to break. {{inputs}} Then you open your browser's responsive mode, set it to 360 pixels, and look at the home page. {{responsive}} The price and the Book link have gone off the edge of the screen. {{defect}} The page's own style says why, and one line of it is enough to find. {{rule}} Last, what responsive mode cannot show you, and where real phones come from when you do not own them. {{devices}}
